user.title: Smart pause for a Versatile Thermostat
user.description: Pause the equipment of an over_climate thermostat while the room does not need it and will hold without it.

data_description.threshold_heat: Below this setpoint (for example a night setback), VTherm's own auto start/stop switches the equipment off and on. From this setpoint up, the smart pause decides. Empty: the smart pause always decides.
data_description.threshold_cool: Above this setpoint, VTherm's own auto start/stop switches the equipment off and on. From this setpoint down, the smart pause decides. Empty: the smart pause always decides.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Hourly forecast of the outdoor temperature and the clouds, used to predict how long the room holds without the equipment.

error.not_a_vtherm: Pick a climate entity of Versatile Thermostat.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a smart pause.

data_description.threshold_heat: Below this setpoint (for example a night setback), VTherm's own auto start/stop switches the equipment off and on. From this setpoint up, the smart pause decides. Empty: the smart pause always decides.
data_description.threshold_cool: Above this setpoint, VTherm's own auto start/stop switches the equipment off and on. From this setpoint down, the smart pause decides. Empty: the smart pause always decides.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Hourly forecast of the outdoor temperature and the clouds, used to predict how long the room holds without the equipment.

pause_rules.name: Pause rules
pause_rules.description: When the smart pause decides: the comfort side of a start/stop threshold, or a mode without a threshold.

data.comfort_excess_minutes: How long the excess must last (min)

data_description.comfort_excess: Pause only when the room is at least this far past the setpoint (above it in heating, below it in cooling). With a room sensor that moves by 0.2 °C, 0.3 means a 0.4 °C excess.
data_description.comfort_excess_minutes: The excess must last this long before a pause.
data_description.comfort_margin: The comfort limit: the room must not go further than this on the uncomfortable side of the setpoint (below it in heating). The pause ends at half this margin, or earlier when the model predicts the limit will be reached.
data_description.comfort_min_pause_minutes: Pause only if the model predicts the room will hold at least this long without the equipment.

setback.name: Setpoint sent while paused
setback.description: What the equipment receives during a pause. Leave both empty unless your unit keeps running at the thermostat's minimum (heating) or maximum (cooling).

data_description.setback_heat: While paused, the equipment receives this low setpoint, so its own thermostat stops the compressor and the unit stays on. Empty: the thermostat's minimum temperature.
data_description.setback_cool: While paused, the equipment receives this high setpoint, so its own thermostat stops the compressor and the unit stays on. Empty: the thermostat's maximum temperature.

guards.name: Compressor protection
guards.description: Limits that keep the equipment from stopping and starting too often.

data.outdoor_floor_heat: Heating: no pause below this outdoor temperature (°C)
data.outdoor_ceiling_cool: Cooling: no pause above this outdoor temperature (°C)

data_description.min_run_minutes: After a resume, the equipment runs at least this long before the next pause.
data_description.min_off_minutes: A pause lasts at least this long, unless comfort calls for an earlier resume.
data_description.max_pauses_per_day: Protects the compressor from too many stops and starts.

fallback_rules.name: Fallback rules
fallback_rules.description: Used only on the eco side of a threshold when VTherm's auto start/stop is not configured on the thermostat. Ignore them otherwise.

data.eco_excess_minutes: How long the excess must last (min)

data_description.eco_excess: Same meaning as the pause rules, with wider margins.
